claims.claim: The rigid radio matches the requested identity, size and visible parts.
claims.evidence: request.md requests about 0.265 x 0.117 x 0.259 m; probes/02_geometry.out measures the visual mesh at 0.26499998 x 0.11700005 x 0.25950001 m. asset/model.urdf names the robot radio and has one body link; asset/asset.json declares kind rigid. All four renders show the body, two cheeks, speaker, two knobs and top handle at the expected reconstruction detail.

claims.claim: Collision geometry represents the visible parts and preserves access to the handle opening.
claims.evidence: readings.json lists nine collision boxes covering the body, cheeks, speaker, knobs and three handle pieces, with no collision meshes. Comparing renders/iso.png, renders/side.png, renders/front.png and renders/top.png with these bounds shows conservative box approximations of rounded parts. probes/02_geometry.out reports all 3431 visual vertices inside the collision union at 1 micrometre tolerance and matching overall bounds. The central handle opening remains empty: x=-0.0745 to 0.0745 m, above z=0.205 and below z=0.2385 m.

claims.claim: Joint travel, moving-part support and inter-link penetration checks are not applicable.
claims.evidence: asset/model.urdf contains a single rigid body link and no joints, as requested. readings.json joints is empty; probes/01_settle.out reports joints {} and overlaps [].

claims.claim: The top handle has sufficient geometric clearance for grasping from above and lifting the rigid radio.
claims.evidence: readings.json Handle_upper bounds give a 0.022 m grip depth across Y, below the 0.08 m gripper opening. probes/02_geometry.out gives 0.149 m clear span between uprights and a conservative 0.0335 m gap under the crossbar, sufficient for the stated approximately 0.02 m finger width. renders/iso.png and renders/top.png show unobstructed approach to the crossbar centre from above. All handle pieces belong to body and overlap their supports. readings.json has no annotated joint handles; joint pulling is not applicable. This is a geometry-based grasp assessment.
request.md requires no place targets and readings.json place_targets is empty.

claims.claim: The radio settles on the ground and remains upright when loaded as a free rigid object.
claims.evidence: probes/02_geometry.out gives minimum collision z=0.0 m. probes/01_settle.py uses Probe("asset", fixed=False, pos=(0,0,0)); probes/01_settle.out records 300 frames (10 seconds). Body pose z settles from 0.12975 to 0.12972 m, final horizontal displacement is about 0.00004 m, and rotation remains within about 0.00009 rad of upright. Four ground contacts total 31.570 N, consistent with the declared 3.218 kg mass.
